kboot.conf.text:
timeout=10
default=linux_hdd
linux_hdd="uda0:/linux-hdd/vmlinuz-linux-xenon root=UUID=e9584d6f-d7ed-40ba-80a2-6834f8d91f31 initrd=uda0:/linux-hdd/initramfs-linux-xenon.img coherent_pool=16M rw"
# Linux live USB - Xbox 360 Xenon. No disk installer is launched by this configuration.
# FAT32 volume label must be ARCH.

linux_usb_uda1="uda1:/arch/boot/ppc/vmlinuz-linux-xenon arch=ppc archisobasedir=arch archisolabel=ARCH initrd=uda1:/arch/boot/ppc/initramfs-linux-xenon.img coherent_pool=16M read-only"
linux_usb_uda0="uda0:/arch/boot/ppc/vmlinuz-linux-xenon arch=ppc archisobasedir=arch archisolabel=ARCH initrd=uda0:/arch/boot/ppc/initramfs-linux-xenon.img coherent_pool=16M read-only"
linux_usb_uda="uda:/arch/boot/ppc/vmlinuz-linux-xenon arch=ppc archisobasedir=arch archisolabel=ARCH initrd=uda:/arch/boot/ppc/initramfs-linux-xenon.img coherent_pool=16M read-only"

# FAT32 volume label must be ARCH.
